这篇文章是给准备在湾区买卖二手物品的人看的。二手交易本身很正常，关键是每次都把面: This guide is for Bay Area buyers and sellers of used items. Secondhand trading is normal; the key is to finish three steps every time: where you meet, how you pay and checking the item.
先判断这笔交易值不值得继续聊: First decide whether this transaction is worth discussing further
二手交易里最常见的问题不是假货有多高级，而是信息太少、节奏太急。价格特别低、描述: The most common problems in secondhand sales are limited information and pressure to rush. An unusually low price, vague description, demands for an advance deposit, or reluctance to share basic photos and condition details usually isn't worth pursuing.
让对方补几张当前实拍；FTC 提醒，看不到实物照片就没法判断成色，也没法确定卖家: Ask for a few current photos. The FTC notes that without pictures of the actual item you can’t check its condition or be sure the seller really has it.
问清楚成色、购买时间、有没有维修过、有没有缺件。: Ask about condition, purchase date, repairs, and missing parts.
如果是电子产品，提前问能不能现场开机、登录、测试主要功能。: For electronics, ask whether you can turn them on, sign in, and test key functions in person.
如果是家具，提前问清尺寸、搬运方式、电梯或楼梯情况。: For furniture, ask about dimensions, moving arrangements, and elevators or stairs in advance.
高价值物品，问有没有原包装、序列号、购买凭证或保修信息。: For valuable items, ask about the original box, serial number, receipt or warranty.
公共地点面交通常比私人住址更稳，尤其是手机、电脑、相机、游戏机这类容易有争议的物: Public locations are generally a better choice than private homes, especially for phones, computers, cameras, and game consoles that can lead to disputes. Daylight, other people around, easy parking, and a nearby place to keep testing an item are more reassuring than an isolated roadside meeting.
优先选商场、咖啡店附近、超市停车场这类公开地点。: Favor public locations such as malls, areas near coffee shops, or supermarket parking lots.
如果要搬大件家具，可以先小额确认，再安排正式搬运时间。: For large furniture, you can confirm with a small payment first, then arrange the full move.
晚间交易要额外考虑照明、停车和周边环境。: For an evening exchange, pay extra attention to lighting, parking, and the surroundings.
很多人面交时不好意思多看，怕显得不信任，结果回家才发现问题。其实二手交易最正常的: People sometimes feel awkward inspecting an item carefully, then discover problems at home. In-person checking is a normal part of buying used goods. Turn it on, test available functions, and verify measurements and accessories. Paying before inspecting often leaves you with fewer options.
FTC 的付款建议（2026-10-14 读取）：尽量用有法律保护的信用卡；电汇: The FTC’s payment advice (read 2026-10-14): use a safer method such as a credit card, which has legal protections. Wire transfers (MoneyGram, Western Union), gift cards, cash reload cards and cryptocurrency are like sending cash, and once the money is gone you generally can’t get it back.
出现这些情况，直接停止交易: Stop the deal when you see these
对方临时改地点，改到很偏或很赶的地方。: They change the meeting place at the last minute to somewhere isolated or pressure you to rush.
说好面交验货，到现场却一直催你先付款。: You agreed to inspect at pickup, but the seller keeps urging you to pay first when you arrive.
实物状态和聊天描述差很多，还一直解释。: The actual condition differs greatly from the description, and the seller keeps making excuses.
电子产品不让开机，也不让检查账号锁定状态。: An electronic device you aren’t allowed to switch on or check for an account lock.
对方要求你先付定金保留，但没有足够信息让你确认物品真实性。: They demand a holding deposit without enough information to confirm the item is real.
面交时多看两分钟、多问两句，不是不信任对方，而是在保护自己。靠谱的卖家通常也希望: Taking two extra minutes to inspect and ask questions is about protecting yourself, not accusing the other person. Reliable sellers usually want buyers to confirm everything on the spot to avoid repeated follow-up messages.
卖东西的人也要保护自己: Sellers need to protect themselves too
卖家提前写明物品情况、收款方式和面交时间，能省掉很多来回；买家一直改时间、临时砍: Sellers: state the item’s condition, how you take payment and when you can meet up front, which saves a lot of back-and-forth; if a buyer keeps changing the time, haggles at the last minute or wants to take the item before paying, say no. The FTC’s advice for sellers: never deposit a check for more than the selling price; don’t share a Google Voice code, or any verification code, with someone you don’t know; don’t accept a mobile payment from a stranger. Many sites recommend selling to a local buyer you meet in person and taking cash only.
别为了省钱或赶快出手，省掉公开地点、验货和安全付款这三步。: Don’t skip the public meeting place, the inspection or a safe payment method just to save money or sell fast.
第一次交易高价值物品，别直接去对方家里，也别让对方来你家。: For a first high-value deal, don’t go straight to the other person’s home or invite them to yours.
没验货，不要先转账或付定金。: Don’t transfer money or pay a deposit before you have checked the item.
卖家要你绕开平台自带的付款方式，就别买（FTC）。: If a seller wants payment outside the marketplace’s own payment system, don’t buy (FTC).
卖家也别为了快出手什么都答应。: Sellers: don’t agree to everything just to sell fast.
